title: Keep It or Return It? My First Impressions Of The Seka Spear

takeaways.text: It set personal bests on his regular loop; it is stiff but less harsh than he feared over 5.5 hours, on 32 mm GP5000s with TPU tubes and 60 mm carbon-spoked wheels.
Descending felt planted and confidence-inspiring even in crosswinds, which he attributes to longer trail and wheelbase plus a 120 mm stem; the integrated bar is very stiff.
Minor negatives: the paint marks easily, so he plans protection film, and the integrated aero bottle cages are heavier than light carbon cages.
He quotes about €3,200 for the RDC edition, with the regular Spear a little cheaper.

disclosure: No supply arrangement is stated; the presenter discusses whether to keep or return the bike he bought.
summary: First impressions of a SEKA Spear RDC after a 140 km test ride in the Black Forest.
